verdict.line: You lose extended 1v1s while Skaarl is alive and healthy, but Ornn's 50.7% win rate over 67 games shows that punishing every dismount and outscaling him with Sunfire Aegis erases that early deficit.

brief.thesis: OP.GG's own numbers give Kled the lane and solo-kill edge because Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) and Jousting (E) let him poke and dash in on his terms while Skaarl's mount bar is full. That edge evaporates once Skaarl's health depletes and Kled dismounts into a weaker, less threatening form — Ornn's whole job is to survive the mounted phase and then nuke the dismount before courage lets him remount.

theirWindow.when: Q and E are both off cooldown
theirWindow.what: He can hook you with Q (Bear Trap on a Rope, 11-7s cooldown, yanks you toward him if shackled) and follow with E (Jousting, 13-9s cooldown, dash-and-dash-back damage) before you can answer. Don't stand still at 800 range when both are up — bait the hook from max range or hold W (Bellows Breath) to advance through it instead of eating the full combo.

yourWindow.what: Kled is dismounted, deals reduced damage to champions, and his Q is replaced by the knockback-only Pocket Pistol. Commit immediately with Q (Volcanic Rupture) into E (Searing Charge) — every second you hesitate is a second he can fight to refill courage and remount with free health.

powerCurve.note: Hook poke and joust dashes bully you
Courage sustain still favors his all-ins
R (Forge God) brings jungler kill windows
Sunfire Aegis burn punishes every dive
Full tank build smothers his damage

start.why: 55.6% win rate over 36 games — the flat damage reduction on hit absorbs Kled's Q hook and early auto trades better than Doran's Helm.

boots.why: 84.8% pick rate and 55.2% win rate — Kled's damage is entirely physical (autos, Q, E, and the attack-speed burst from W), so flat percent reduction cuts every part of his kit.

core.why: The burn punishes him for dashing in with Jousting (E) or sitting in melee range during Violent Tendencies (W).
Appears in every measured 100%-win-rate core path against him — pure physical damage profile means the reflect and grievous wounds hit hard.
Stacks with Ornn's passive bonus armor/MR and adds sustain for the extended skirmishes Kled forces while mounted.
Shows up in the top-performing core path — the shield buys time to survive burst from his dismounted Pocket Pistol poke.

situational.when: he's resetting autos on you hard before your first full item completes
the game runs long and you need the extra resistance scaling over a fourth tank item

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on every trade he initiates with Q or E, turning his aggression into sustain and matching the top two measured rune pages for this matchup.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest-winning and most-picked combo (52.8% win rate, 68.8% pick) — Teleport lets you hit item spikes and reset back to lane for the scaling plan this matchup requires.

playing.title: Play passive levels 1-3
playing.detail: Last-hit and poke with Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9s cooldown at rank 1) from max range instead of trading into his hook-and-joust combo while Skaarl is fresh.

playing.title: Hold W to advance through hooks
playing.detail: Per the matchup's own tip, Bellows Breath's advance can carry you through the pull window of Bear Trap on a Rope instead of getting yanked into his damage.

playing.title: Call jungler once R is live
playing.detail: From level 6, Call of the Forge God's slow travel time and Brittle application make it a strong setup for a jungler gank — ping the moment he overextends with Jousting.

playing.title: All-in only on the dismount
playing.detail: Wait for Skaarl's bar to hit zero, then burst with Q into E (Searing Charge) — he deals less damage to champions while dismounted and can't re-hook you with Q.

playing.title: Respect Violent Tendencies spikes
playing.detail: His W gives massive attack speed for four hits with a heavier fourth attack — disengage or block with armor stacking rather than trading through it.

playing.title: Prioritize Thornmail by item two if behind
playing.detail: If his early lane/solo-kill advantage converts into a kill, rushing Thornmail after Sunfire Aegis caps his physical burst before he snowballs further.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates/sample sizes above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (67 Ornn-vs-Kled games, 10,173 Ornn-top games overall); the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Use [W] to avoid being pulled by Kled’s (Q). Kled will often play aggressively so try to call you jungler for a gank to kill him using [R]. Try to nuke Kled quickly when he dismounts as he can turn the tables around if he mounts Skaal again.
